notes: Strict 2024 Premier Cru production paths for Pouilly-Loché and Pouilly-Vinzelles. Only the newly homologated Premier Cru paths are promoted here because this Burgundy closeout tranche is intentionally GC/PC-scoped. Manual-harvest transition provisions are not collapsed into an unconditional timeless boolean; they require vintage-aware representation.
